prompt:

No text, borders, panel labels, shadows or background. Column order exactly: FRONT, RIGHT, LEFT, REAR. Every cell MUST show a LOW, FLAT horizontal floor-tile EDGE ELEVATION. Camera is level and axis-aligned at tile-edge height. Each view is a very shallow horizontal brick slab with its low exterior side face and a slim pale-tan stone curb side face only where physically on that edge. Do not show the top face, any square plan, an L silhouette standing upright, or an upright post. All four views have the same shallow Z height and same edge length, centered at a shared baseline.

Match the provided native source exactly: dark burnt-orange square pavers with dark mortar, distressed pale tan stone curb blocks. The source plan is an L-shaped flat tile with pale stone curb running along two perpendicular arms: one far/back arm and the right-hand arm as seen from above. Preserve that fixed world-side arrangement. FRONT sees the near long edge, which has no curb; RIGHT sees the right-hand long curb edge as a low pale stone band; LEFT sees the opposite plain orange-brick edge, with no raised corner block; REAR sees the far long curb edge as a low pale stone band. Keep curb flush and integrated into the shallow floor slab; no tall wall or vertical corner tower. Orthographic elevation, no foreshortening, no three-quarter angle. Small illustrated texture detail should match source, not introduce new motifs.

Negative: no top-down view, no visible patterned top surface, no upright wall, no corner post, no raised block at one end, no full square tile viewed obliquely, no extra curb on front/left sides, no loose pieces, no perspective.
